banned-api.time.sleep: [no-sleep] a fixed sleep waits on time, not on the event -> block on the event itself (subprocess.run, Future.result, a queue get, a lock); prevent it: wait on what produces the result . ref: no polling
banned-api.asyncio.sleep: [no-sleep] an async sleep is a timed wait -> await the event itself (an asyncio.Event, a Future, a stream read); prevent it: wait on what produces the result . ref: no polling
banned-api.anyio.sleep: [no-sleep] a timed wait -> await the event itself (anyio.Event, a stream receive); prevent it: wait on what produces the result . ref: no polling
banned-api.trio.sleep: [no-sleep] a timed wait -> await the event itself (trio.Event, a channel receive); prevent it: wait on what produces the result . ref: no polling
banned-api.threading.Timer: [no-sleep] a timer polls on a clock -> react to the event that makes the work due (a callback, a queue, a notify); prevent it: wire the producer to the consumer . ref: no polling
banned-api.sched.scheduler: [no-sleep] a scheduler waits on a clock -> react to the event that makes the work due; prevent it: wire the producer to the consumer . ref: no polling

hooks.name: bh review (design-affecting or triggered pushes; never blocks)
hooks.entry: sh -c 'to=${PRE_COMMIT_TO_REF:-HEAD}; from=$PRE_COMMIT_FROM_REF; bh=$(git config --local --get bh.bin); [ -x "$bh" ] || bh=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-/nonexistent}/bin/bh; [ -x "$bh" ] || bh=$(command -v bh) || { echo "[review] bh was not found, the push was not reviewed -> run bh run once in this project from Claude Code (it records the plugin path in this clone), or run bh review BASE..HEAD with the plugin bin/ on PATH"; exit 0; }; case "$from" in *[!0]*) ;; *) new=$(git rev-list "$to" --not --remotes | tail -n 1); [ -n "$new" ] || { echo "[review] no commit on this branch is new to the remote, nothing to review"; exit 0; }; top=$(git symbolic-ref -q --short "refs/remotes/${PRE_COMMIT_REMOTE_NAME:-origin}/HEAD"); from=$(git merge-base "$to" "$top" 2>/dev/null) || from=$(git rev-parse "$new^" 2>/dev/null) || { echo "[review] the branch has no base to review from -> run bh review BASE..HEAD"; exit 0; };; esac; "$bh" review "$from..$to"; exit 0'
